source: results/rustmap_rosetta.json (run_rosetta.py with RustMap's own build commands: plain `gcc main.c` (+ -lm) and plain `rustc` -- audit 4), all 37 real divergences, classified by hand from the full outputs
c_ub_check: the 11 counted C programs built with gcc -fsanitize=address,undefined and run: no UB report (knapsack_problem_0_1 reports only a LeakSanitizer leak); chaocipher C has a heap-buffer-overflow and is excluded

wrong_output_S1.box_the_compass: headings/indices shifted (Rust row 1 is ' 2 North by east 0.00')
wrong_output_S1.isbn13_check_digit: Rust prints 'bad' for the two valid ISBNs
wrong_output_S1.knapsack_problem_0_1: Rust selects only 'map' (totals 9 150) instead of the optimal set
wrong_output_S1.knapsack_problem_continuous: Rust prints 'take all beef' instead of salami/ham/brawn/greaves/3.5kg welt
wrong_output_S1.sexy_primes: Rust prints nothing (exit 0); C prints the pair/triplet counts and lists
wrong_output_S1.formatted_numeric_output: prints 000-7.125 for -7.125 (C ' -0007.125'); C clean under ASan/UBSan (audit 5: reclassified from cosmetic)
wrong_output_S1.approximate_equility: (-2.0).sqrt()*(-2.0).sqrt() -> prints NaN where the C prints -2; C clean (audit 5: reclassified from cosmetic)

rust_panic.matrix_chain_multiplication: exit 101 (add overflow in debug build; under -O it printed cost 45 vs C 48)

different_task_or_inputs_not_counted.lu_decomposition: shipped Rust is a Luhn checker
different_task_or_inputs_not_counted.array_length: Rust prints 1..9,0; C prints the array length 2
different_task_or_inputs_not_counted.perfect_numbers: Rust asks for an argument ('Enter an argument. Example 1234 or dcba')
different_task_or_inputs_not_counted.runge_kutta_method: Rust prints a list of semiprimes
different_task_or_inputs_not_counted.number_names: Rust names a single different number (321)

nondeterministic_C_not_counted.machine_code: C output differs between runs (26018, 29289): it executes raw machine code

cosmetic_note: formatting, float precision, nan/NaN, quoting, list display, blank lines, program name, 0 vs None
counts_superseded_by_ledger: These are the submission version's hand-triage classes: 11 counted (9 wrong output + 2 panics) and 8 set aside as a different task. The defect ledger reads this file and re-applies the v2 rules (scripts/build_defect_ledger.py ROSETTA_V2, recorded with reasons in results/defect_ledger.json meta.RustMap.rosetta_triage_v2): number_names and numerical_integration move from different task to wrong output, so the paper counts 13 and sets aside 6. The classes above are kept as triaged; the ledger is authoritative.

excluded_C_UB.chaocipher: Rust ciphertext differs, but the C has an ASan heap-buffer-overflow, so not counted (audit 5)
